sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and Verification, Section Eight Stopping and Following

Section D records the accuracy posture for the Section Eight stopping and following rules. Every knowledge fact is required to trace to its cited handbook page, with the cited page stating the fact in full. Confidence is high across the section because every rule comes from the single pinned handbook edition. The emergency-stopping table extracts with scrambled columns, so no cell value is asserted and only the prose factors and step times are taught. The four-count gap tip and the three-second rule with its four-second bad-weather extension are each stated as printed on their own page. Handbook wording is paraphrased throughout; no official sentence, table, or question is reproduced. No time-variable or location-variable fact appears beyond the pinned edition, so nothing required isolation as dynamic knowledge.
